reviewed_invariants: Factories fully initialize inline pointer-free payloads and validate ranges, CRT inverses and modulus width once.
Montgomery R squared, qInvMont and inverse words match independent Python integers, including qInv with191 leading zero bytes.
Fixed1536-bit factors and192-byte exponents select the unchanged constant-time five-bit i31 primitive on both direct and prepared paths.
Temporary secret scratch is initialized and explicitly cleared; mandatory public signature self-check and output clearing remain.
Typed immutable nominal handles justify omitting redundant per-call context metadata checks.
The restricted RSA-PSS import rejection remains intact.
scope_limits: Runtime private-key validation checks consistency, not primality; the OpenSSL import tool performs key checking.
Native corrupted-context injections preserve valid shape and test fault defense; Motoko cannot forge raw handles through this API.
Managed secret payloads and earlier GC copies are not promised to be erased when references are dropped.
Portable interpreter arithmetic is a correctness reference with variable timing.
Differential tests and sanitizers are not a formal constant-time proof or comprehensive cryptanalysis.
